title: Check the complete paired row set.

**Check the complete paired row set.**

`baseRows.get(r.id)` returns `undefined` for an unmatched ID, so the paired-count check silently excludes that row. Compare the baseline and current row IDs with the sample IDs before calculating improvements and regressions.
